explanation: OEIS A175386 (a(n) = denominator of Σ_{i=1}^n (1/i) C(2n−i−1, i−1)): 'We conjecture that sum(...) is not an integer for n>1' (since proved). The formal a takes the reduced denominator of this rational sum (2n − (i+1) = 2n − i − 1 for i ≤ n), and 'a(n) ≠ 1 for n > 1' is exactly non-integrality. Checked numerically for 2 ≤ n < 300. Faithful.
